description.0: A longsword brimming with light and color, and as weightless as a butterfly when brandished. It was once used by a certain individual to break bonds.

0.0: Each time the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they gain one of the following three effects in sequence:
0.1: Winds of Devotion: Increases the equipping character's CRIT DMG by <cryo>56%</cryo> for 10s;
0.2: Winds of Defiance: Increases Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by <cryo>36%</cryo> for 10s; and
0.3: Winds of Plenty: Regenerates <cryo>5</cryo> Elemental Energy for the equipping character. Up to <cryo>5</cryo> Elemental Energy can be regenerated in this way every 4s.
0.4: The aforementioned effects are removed and the sequence is reset when the equipping character leaves the field.
